reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline or comment, which is the expected output; the cited paragraphs support that conclusion.

Section 9(b) contains a genuine express warranty package covering performance to industry standards (p0034), freedom from errors materially affecting utility (p0038), no malicious code (p0036) and ongoing compliance with Law (p0041), satisfying the preferred position's substantive elements.

Duration is continuing for the Term rather than a fixed 90-day/12-month window, so the failed deterministic regex (which looks for an explicit day/month period) is a phrasing artifact, not a shortfall — a Term-long warranty is more favourable than the preferred parameter.

The Section 13 disclaimer is double-carved ('Except as expressly set forth herein' and 'except for the representations and warranties set forth in this Agreement'), so it does not swallow the express warranty and the clause is nowhere near walk-away 'AS IS' territory.

The absence of an express repair/re-perform/refund remedy sentence is correctly treated as a sub-element noted in the rationale rather than a deviation, and the observation that no exclusive-remedy cap preserves our full damages rights is accurate and consistent with not flagging clauses that benefit our party.
